cvStructure.issue: There is no dedicated Skills section; tools such as Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, SQL, Pandas, Power BI, and Git are only mentioned inside long experience/project descriptions.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a short 'Technical Skills' section that lists these tools explicitly so ATS systems can match them to the AI/ML Engineer role.

cvStructure.issue: The CV has no link to a GitHub, portfolio, or LinkedIn profile, which is valuable evidence for an AI/ML Engineer applicant with several hands-on projects.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a GitHub or portfolio link near the contact details so recruiters can view the code for the Tweets Mood Checker and House Price Guesser projects.

sectionOrganization.issue: The experience section heading is spelled 'EXPERIANCE' instead of 'EXPERIENCE'.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: Correct the heading to 'EXPERIENCE' so it is recognized consistently by ATS parsers.

sectionOrganization.issue: Experience entries are not ordered most recent first: Student Lab Assistant (09/2023-05/2024) is listed before Data Science Trainee (March-June 2025) and Machine Learning Intern (2025), which are more recent.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: Reorder the experience section so Machine Learning Intern and Data Science Trainee appear before Student Lab Assistant.

keywordUsage.issue: Several project and internship descriptions use informal, everyday phrasing instead of standard ML/AI terms, for example 'says which kind it is' instead of 'image classification' and 'decides if the writer is happy, angry or neutral' instead of 'sentiment analysis'.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Replace these descriptions with the standard technical terms (e.g., image classification, sentiment analysis, text classification) so recruiters and ATS keyword scans recognize the relevant AI/ML skills.

readability.issue: Many bullet points are written as first-person narration ('I made...', 'I collected...', 'I gathered...') rather than starting with strong action verbs.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite these bullets to begin with action verbs, for example 'Developed a mobile app that classifies date fruit images' instead of 'I made a phone app that looks at a picture of dates and says which kind it is'.

readability.issue: The graduation project result 'it got it right most of the time' is vague and lacks a specific metric, unlike the quantified result given for the Machine Learning Intern role.
readability.suggestion: State the actual model accuracy or evaluation metric if available, similar to the '35% reduction in response time' example used elsewhere.

readability.issue: The Student Lab Assistant bullets are generic, such as 'Duties included various tasks given by the lab supervisor', which does not convey a clear skill or achievement.
readability.suggestion: Replace this line with a specific responsibility or outcome, such as the exact lab systems managed or number of students supported.

contentFormatting.issue: Dates are formatted inconsistently across the CV, mixing 'MM/YYYY' (09/2023), 'Month YYYY' (March 2025), and year-only (2025) formats.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Use one consistent date format, such as 'MM/YYYY', for all entries in Education, Experience, and Projects.

contentFormatting.issue: The Machine Learning Intern role is dated '2025 - present' even though the description states the internship finished in September 2025, which contradicts today's date of 2026-11-22.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Change the date range to '06/2025 - 09/2025' (or the exact months) instead of 'present' since the internship has already ended.
